purpose: 铜钥匙、未点燃红烛、念珠与通行凭的当前物品图生成规范

assets.name: 铜钥匙·物品图
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: ONE standalone inventory item illustration for the fixed-view 2D Chinese narrative game 《红烛无声》, used in small bag slots and a larger item-detail view.
Style: realistic ordinary prop proportions rendered in the game's restrained TWO-DIMENSIONAL HAND-DRAWN style. Thin dark contour lines, broad matte local-color planes, a few simply drawn shadows, sparse meaningful wear and very light paper-like drawing quality. Soft neutral warm-gray lighting. Small-scale silhouette must read clearly. No glossy 3D product render, photo realism, dense painterly texture, fantasy embellishment, horror-poster styling or cute cartoon.
Composition: SQUARE 1024x1024 canvas, one complete object centered in BOTH axes. Its longest dimension occupies about 76-82% of the square with comfortable transparent margin all around. Keep all tips/edges intact. The prop is separate from the scene and from the interface. No surface, table, hand, human, pedestal or packaging unless the specific object description requires it.
Delivery: true transparent alpha outside the EXACT object silhouette, including holes and gaps; solid material opaque with antialiasing at the contour only. No solid black/white background, gradient, shadow cloud, external glow, vignette, painted checkerboard, UI frame, caption, item name, watermark or extra object. Do not draw any lettering, pseudo-writing or numerals: exact clue text will be typeset separately.

REFERENCE ROLES AND SPECIFIC OBJECT:
Image 1 is the EXACT current key identity reference: the single copper key situated at the lower right of a mostly transparent canvas. Ignore its transparent margins, inspect that key and render the SAME key enlarged at the center. Image 2 is only the 2D linework and matte rendering-style reference.
Subject: one worn warm-brass/copper-colored old room key, with the same thick oval open ring-shaped bow, short straight round-section shaft, and simple stepped bit with the same tooth structure as Image 1. Diagonal upper-left bow to lower-right bit, mild three-quarter angle that shows the shaft thickness and entire open bow. The ring hole must be truly transparent. A faint worn abstract mark near the bow-to-shaft joint may be two barely visible short incised strokes, never readable letters or a new emblem. Retain small edge rubs, subdued ochre highlights and brown shadow planes. No keyring, bunch of keys, modern serrated flat key, padlock, tag, cord, tray or hand.
Painting treatment: calm broad matte ochre base planes, a few large brown shadow bands and subdued ochre highlights; only sparse rubbed edge marks. No all-over metallic mottling or shiny white streaks.
